agent_explanation: Two heavy bodies fall into a nearly head-on deep close encounter (separation 0.94 at step29 ->0.70 at step30 ->0.43 at step31 ->0.105 at step32, below softening 0.3). Leapfrog substepping grows only 11->12->13->16 substeps per outer step, so effective timestep stays too large versus the short dynamical time / huge acceleration (|potential| grows 1224->3809, kinetic 1250->3517). Energy drifts progressively 26.1->1.1->-102->-292, exceeding tolerance at step32. Momentum stays conserved, indicating a pure time-integration accuracy failure, not force asymmetry. Reducing dt alone removes the failure.
